title: Predict the order
description:
The class `Noisy` (already written) appends `+name` to a log when it is created and `-name` when it is destroyed.

Fill in the body of `demo` so that, after it returns, the log reads **exactly**:

```
+A+B+C-C-B+D-D-A
```

You may only create `Noisy` objects and use braces `{ }` to open and close scopes. Remember: objects are destroyed at the closing brace of their scope, in the reverse of the order they were created.
hints: B and C are destroyed before D is created, so they must live in an inner scope that closes first. D and A are destroyed at the end of the function: D first, because it was created last.
unitTests: TEST("the log matches") { std::string log; demo(log); CHECK_EQ(log, "+A+B+C-C-B+D-D-A"); }

grading.unitTests: TEST("the log matches") { std::string log; demo(log); CHECK_EQ(log, "+A+B+C-C-B+D-D-A"); }
